entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF77819.

Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. So, to understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fault. It's just not working.
I'm sorry to hear that. Could you describe what's happening? You said it's not working?
It won't sync. I've tried reconnecting it a dozen times. The thing is basically broken.
I see. It sounds like the unit itself might be defective. I understand how frustrating that must be. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked our policy, and since you're within the 90-day return window, I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately. No problem at all.
Oh. I guess that's one thing that works then.

I'm processing that for you now and I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just package the defective band in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
Whatever. Just make sure it comes through.
It will. Was there anything else I could help you with today, Sam?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit, and I apologize for the trouble with your sensor.
